title: QUIC RFC 9000 S17P2P4 Handshake Packet Format Proof Tail Verification
verification_method: Focused S17P2P4 requirement-home tests over handshake packet header parsing, first-send packet-number zero, coalesced client receipt boundaries, and allowed-versus-forbidden handshake frame payloads, followed by coverage triage regeneration, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the focused generated S17P2P4 hard proof tail for handshake packet format parsing, packet-number zero on first send, client receipt boundaries, and handshake payload acceptance/rejection.
expected_result: The focused tests show that handshake packet headers parse with the expected long-header shape, the first server handshake packet uses packet number 0, truncated protected handshake packets fail to open, the largest four-byte packet-number boundary remains representable, initial-only client receipt does not commit peer transport parameters, coalesced Initial+Handshake receipt does commit them, allowed Handshake-packet CONNECTION_CLOSE transitions to draining without a local protocol-violation close, and RESET_STREAM still triggers PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
procedure: Run the focused S17P2P4 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: QuicHandshakeFlowCoordinator and QuicPacketParser still expose the handshake packet assembly and open seams used by the requirement-home tests.
The packet-number field remains constrained to RFC 9000's one-to-four-byte packet header encoding space.
The client and server TLS state observations used by the requirement-home tests remain accessible through the existing test helpers.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim broader RFC 9000 packet-family closure, public API widening, hosted interop readiness, or closure of unrelated deferred fuzz obligations.

status_summary: Focused S17P2P4 verification passed for packet/header parsing, coalesced receipt boundaries, allowed Handshake-packet CONNECTION_CLOSE handling, SpecTrace validation, and diff checking; all seven S17P2P4 requirements are trace_clean, and the broader Release suite has unrelated INT failures outside this lane.
